g.text: Graph revision AD - ga_front: Keys: 1000 x 600 x 800 mm envelope - the node size_mm (study default envelope box, read back from the cad/stl registry (M0 study envelope; design sizing per the duty sheet follows)); the build fills it exactly (hold-down frame pins the box)

Graph revision AD - ga_front: Machine-shop fitout per the node continuous note authority (AQS-MFG-010 rev C, Table 2.1): six shop machine tools as purchased-class envelopes per plan rule 6 - CNC vertical mill 7.5 kW, engine lathe 5.5 kW, band saw 1.5 kW, rotary-screw air compressor 4.0 kW, TIG/MIG welder 6.0 kW, bench set 2.0 kW; connected 26.5 kW, one 8 h shift, average 2.55 kW
Graph revision AD - ga_front: The four metal-forming tools (melt, atomiser, mill, drawer) are metered at their own units since the rev C split - not part of this fitout
Graph revision AD - ga_front: A-MACH: hold-down/guard frame + 8 slab anchors; shop-air DN15 header with four drop legs
